title: Emperor Palpatine
subtitle: Galactic Ruler
text: Action [1 resource, exhaust, defeat a friendly unit]: Deal 1 damage to a unit and draw a card.
deployBox:
When Deployed: Take control of a damaged non-leader unit.

On Attack: You may defeat another friendly unit. If you do, deal 1 damage to a unit and draw a card.
epicAction: Epic Action: If you control 8 or more resources, deploy this leader.
